question:
A solid cube of volume 13824 cm³ is cut into 8 cubes of equal volume. The ratio of the surface area of the original cube to the sum of the surface areas of three of the smaller cubes is:

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 4:3

Volume of cube = a³

According to the question

8a3 = 13824

a3 = 1728

a = 12

side of smaller cube = 12 cm

side of original cube = \(\sqrt[3]{13824}\) = 24 cm

surface area of cube = 6a²

\(larger \over smaller\) = \({6\times24^2 \over 3\times6\times12^2} = {4 \over 3 } \) = 4:3

question:
The length and breadth of a cuboid is increased by 20% and 25%, respectively, while its height is reduced by 30%. What must be the total percentage increase/decrease in the volume of the cuboid?

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:

आयतन → 40  :  42

आयतन में वृद्धि = \((42-40) \over 40\) × 100 % = 5%
